label: D1 after a rewarded a1->S2 rare transition that follows another rare transition
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2). 89% of activation mass is at D1 right after the previous trial took a1 and reached S2 via a rare transition (prev_action=1, prev_common=0; a2->S1 rare gives almost nothing). Previous reward modulates magnitude: rewarded (in_rew=1) carries 95% of mass and gives the strong activations (up to max); unrewarded a1->S2R gives only weak activations (~0.05-0.15 of max). The strongest firing needs a streak of rare transitions: if the trial before the previous one was also rare, precision rises from 0.15 to 0.53 (dev F1 0.46, mass recall 0.67). Magnitude is also higher when the model policy logit already favours a1 (choice>2 raises precision to ~0.78) and earlier in the episode; no activation after trial ~80. All variables are observed (past history); no future variable needed. Precision remains incomplete: many rewarded a1->S2R D1 steps stay silent, so the predicate is only a partial description.
